summary: Iteration 12 both-tested: Daily Goal backend + Recipe Variety / Daily Challenge frontend. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_daily_goal.py with 7 pytest tests covering GET status shape, active-metric-only progress isolation, progress accumulation, claim-requires-complete (400), claim happy path grants exact reward once, second claim -> 400 'Already claimed', progress-after-claim frozen, and 404 for unknown player. All 7 PASSED. Frontend: (a) /serve?dishId=american_hoagie now shows tray-pickle AND tray-hot_sauce (special_options) on every reload, and the gold '⭐ SPECIAL ORDER • BONUS TIP!' badge appeared on customers across reloads (probabilistic ~22%, confirmed on reload 1 of 4). (b) Home screen renders daily-goal-card with icon (🍽️), 'DAILY CHALLENGE' label, goal name ('Serve 25 Customers'), '+120 🪙' pill, progress bar and '0/25' text on a fresh player. After pushing progress to target via /api/players/{id}/daily-goal-progress, the card auto-refreshed within ~3s to show '25/25' + CLAIM button. Tapping claim-goal-button increased coin-balance by exactly 120 (100 → 220) and the card switched to '✓ Claimed'. React Native deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/resizeMode/pointerEvents) still noisy but non-blocking (already reported in iter 11).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' / 'textShadow' shorthand. (Non-blocking; pre-existing.)
'props.pointerEvents' is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: rushBanner/chantBubble/milestoneOverlay/jackpotOverlay in /app/frontend/app/serve.tsx (lines 670, 676, 682, 692).

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Migrate remaining deprecated RN Web props: shadow*/textShadow*/resizeMode/pointerEvents to their newer equivalents.

(Optional) Consider snapshotting the active daily goal id in the player's daily_goal doc so behavior remains deterministic if DAILY_GOALS ordering ever changes mid-day (currently derived from UTC ordinal on each request).
critical_code_review_comments: daily_goal_progress correctly ignores non-active metrics by only reading payload[goal['metric']] — verified with 4 non-active metrics set to 500-999 producing 0 progress.
claim_daily_goal is idempotent: sets daily_goal.claimed=true and re-claim raises 400 'Already claimed'; verified reward is credited exactly once (delta=120 on Serve 25 Customers goal).
daily_goal_progress guards further increments with `if inc > 0 and not dg.get('claimed')` — verified post-claim progress calls do not advance the counter (stays at target).
_daily_goal_view clamps returned progress to target (min(progress, goal['target'])), avoiding UI overflow.
Frontend correctly reports 5 counters in one call via api.reportDailyGoal(finishLevel in serve.tsx:419-425); the backend only credits the active one, so this is safe.
serve.tsx buildCustomers filters special_options OUT of the normal topping pool (specialSet) so specials only appear via the ~22% special roll — matches product intent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (special orders tray/badge + daily-goal card + claim flow all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test players via POST /api/players (usernames TEST_dailygoal, TESTChef, TESTChef3-5) — each isolated per-test; no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Today's daily goal is 'Serve 25 Customers' (id serve25, metric customers_served, target 25, reward 120) — rotates by UTC ordinal, so this may differ on other test days. AsyncStorage key on web is 'philly_fare_player_id'. Home screen's goal card is fetched fire-and-forget on load and refreshed via a 3s polling loadPlayer interval, so allow ~3-5s for progress/CLAIM state changes to reflect after backend pokes. Serve screen deep-link works with just dishId+level; the ~22% special_order roll may need multiple reloads to observe the badge but the tray specials (pickle/hot_sauce/etc) are always rendered.
